  "description": "Welcome to Teestone Hotel &amp; Apartments, a modern boutique hotel located in the peaceful neighborhood of Ikeja and only 15 minutes from Murtala Muhammed International Airport.

For travelers searching for hotels in Ikeja, Teestone offers the perfect combination of comfort, convenience, and contemporary hospitality. Whether you are visiting Lagos for business, attending meetings in Ikeja, catching an early flight, or simply planning a relaxing staycation, our hotel provides a stylish and welcoming environment designed to make your stay memorable.

We are&nbsp;recruiting to fill the position below:

&nbsp;Job Position: Experienced Hotel Front Desk Personnel&nbsp;

Job Location: Ojodu Berger, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time
Department: Front Office
Reports To: Front Office Supervisor / Hotel Manager

Job Summary


	The Front Desk Officer is responsible for providing excellent customer service to guests by managing check-ins and check-outs, handling reservations, responding to inquiries, and ensuring a smooth and welcoming guest experience.
	The role serves as the first point of contact for guests and represents the hotel&#39;s professional image.


Key Responsibilities


	Welcome guests warmly and provide exceptional customer service.
	Perform guest check-in and check-out procedures efficiently.
	Manage room reservations, cancellations, and modifications.
	Answer phone calls, emails, and guest inquiries promptly and professionally.
	Provide information about hotel services, facilities, and local attractions.
	Handle guest requests, complaints, and concerns, escalating issues when necessary.
	Maintain accurate guest records and update reservation systems.
	Process payments, issue receipts, and reconcile daily transactions.
	Coordinate with housekeeping, maintenance, and other departments to meet guest needs.
	Ensure the reception area is clean, organized, and presentable at all times.
	Monitor room availability and occupancy status.
	Follow hotel policies, procedures, and security standards.


Requirements and Qualifications


	Minimum of an HND or a Bachelor&#39;s degree in Hospitality Management, Business Administration, or a related field.
	Previous experience in a front desk, receptionist, or customer service role is an advantage.
	Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
	Proficiency in Microsoft Office and hotel management software.
	Good organizational and multitasking abilities.
	Professional appearance and positive attitude.
	Ability to work flexible shifts, including weekends and public holidays.
	Strong problem-solving and conflict-resolution skills.


Method of Application&nbsp;
Interested and qualified candidates should submit their CV and other relevant information to teestonejobs@gmail.com using the Job Position as the subject of the mail.",

Whether you are visiting Lagos for business, attending meetings in Ikeja, catching an early flight, or simply planning a relaxing staycation, our hotel provides a stylish and welcoming environment designed to make your stay memorable.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Experienced Hotel Front Desk Personnel 
     

            
    



Job Location: Ojodu Berger, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time
Department: Front Office
Reports To: Front Office Supervisor / Hotel Manager

Job Summary


	The Front Desk Officer is responsible for providing excellent customer service to guests by managing check-ins and check-outs, handling reservations, responding to inquiries, and ensuring a smooth and welcoming guest experience.
	The role serves as the first point of contact for guests and represents the hotel's professional image.

	Welcome guests warmly and provide exceptional customer service.

	Process payments, issue receipts, and reconcile daily transactions.

	Ensure the reception area is clean, organized, and presentable at all times.
	Monitor room availability and occupancy status.
	Follow hotel policies, procedures, and security standards.

	Minimum of an HND or a Bachelor's degree in Hospitality Management, Business Administration, or a related field.

  "description": "Trucrete Solutions Limited is dynamic Construction Management firm with expertise in Infrastructural Development, Engineering Services, Procurement, Facility Management, and General Contracting. With several groundbreaking engineering projects in our portfolio over the years, Trucrete is proud to have been involved in shaping Nigeria by elevating critical infrastructure to international standards, erecting buildings, bridges, flyovers and roads in key strategic locations in Nigeria. We have helped create a safer and more pleasant environment, all while encouraging state growth and development.

Our fleet of plant machinery and equipment gives us the capacity to successfully undertake multiple projects in various parts of Nigeria at any one time, while our network of tried and tested subcontractors and suppliers throughout the country and globally, enables us to procure the best resources for every project.

We are&nbsp;recruiting to fill the position below:

&nbsp;Job Position: Structure Engineer&nbsp;

Job Location: Lagos

Job Description


	We areseeking a highly experienced Structural Engineer to oversee the structural engineering aspects of our construction projects.
	The ideal candidate will be responsible for structural analysis, design review, site implementation, quality control, and ensuring that structural works are executed safely and in accordance with approved drawings, specifications, and relevant standards.


Key Responsibilities


	Perform and review structural analysis and engineering calculations for construction projects.
	Review structural drawings, designs, specifications, and technical documentation.
	Supervise the execution of structural works on-site to ensure compliance with approved drawings and specifications.
	Ensure structural works meet applicable codes, standards, quality, and safety requirements.
	Monitor construction activities involving foundations, columns, beams, slabs, reinforcement, concrete works, and other structural elements.
	Identify and resolve structural and technical issues encountered during construction.
	Conduct site inspections and ensure appropriate corrective actions are taken where necessary.
	Review construction materials and ensure they meet required structural specifications and quality standards.
	Prepare technical reports, site reports, calculations, and other project documentation.
	Coordinate with Architects, MEP Engineers, Project Managers, Site Engineers, consultants, contractors, and other stakeholders.
	Monitor structural works against project schedules and support the timely delivery of projects.


Requirements


	Master&rsquo;s Degree in Structural Engineering or a related discipline.
	Minimum of 10 years of relevant experience in structural engineering, preferably within the construction industry.
	Strong knowledge of structural analysis, design principles, construction methods, and relevant engineering standards.
	Strong proficiency in AutoCAD, Revit/BIM, and relevant structural engineering/design software.
	Proven experience supervising and inspecting structural construction works.
	Ability to interpret and review structural drawings, calculations, specifications, and other technical documents.
	Strong understanding of reinforced concrete, steel structures, foundations, and other structural systems.
	Excellent analytical, technical, and problem-solving abilities.
	Strong communication, coordination, and teamwork skills.
	Relevant professional registration/certification, such as COREN, will be an added advantage.


Method of Application&nbsp;
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CVs to: trucretecareers@trucreteng.com using &ldquo;Application &ndash; Structural Engineer&rdquo; as the subject of the mail.",

Structure Engineer Job at Trucrete Solutions Limited




        
    

        
        Trucrete Solutions Limited is dynamic Construction Management firm with expertise in Infrastructural Development, Engineering Services, Procurement, Facility Management, and General Contracting. With several groundbreaking engineering projects in our portfolio over the years, Trucrete is proud to have been involved in shaping Nigeria by elevating critical infrastructure to international standards, erecting buildings, bridges, flyovers and roads in key strategic locations in Nigeria. We have helped create a safer and more pleasant environment, all while encouraging state growth and development.
     

            
    



Our fleet of plant machinery and equipment gives us the capacity to successfully undertake multiple projects in various parts of Nigeria at any one time, while our network of tried and tested subcontractors and suppliers throughout the country and globally, enables us to procure the best resources for every project.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Structure Engineer 

Job Location: Lagos

Job Description


	We areseeking a highly experienced Structural Engineer to oversee the structural engineering aspects of our construction projects.
	The ideal candidate will be responsible for structural analysis, design review, site implementation, quality control, and ensuring that structural works are executed safely and in accordance with approved drawings, specifications, and relevant standards.


Key Responsibilities


	Perform and review structural analysis and engineering calculations for construction projects.
	Review structural drawings, designs, specifications, and technical documentation.
	Supervise the execution of structural works on-site to ensure compliance with approved drawings and specifications.
	Ensure structural works meet applicable codes, standards, quality, and safety requirements.
	Monitor construction activities involving foundations, columns, beams, slabs, reinforcement, concrete works, and other structural elements.
	Identify and resolve structural and technical issues encountered during construction.
	Conduct site inspections and ensure appropriate corrective actions are taken where necessary.
	Review construction materials and ensure they meet required structural specifications and quality standards.
	Prepare technical reports, site reports, calculations, and other project documentation.
	Coordinate with Architects, MEP Engineers, Project Managers, Site Engineers, consultants, contractors, and other stakeholders.
	Monitor structural works against project schedules and support the timely delivery of projects.


Requirements


	Master’s Degree in Structural Engineering or a related discipline.
	Minimum of 10 years of relevant experience in structural engineering, preferably within the construction industry.
	Strong knowledge of structural analysis, design principles, construction methods, and relevant engineering standards.
	Strong proficiency in AutoCAD, Revit/BIM, and relevant structural engineering/design software.
	Proven experience supervising and inspecting structural construction works.
	Ability to interpret and review structural drawings, calculations, specifications, and other technical documents.
	Strong understanding of reinforced concrete, steel structures, foundations, and other structural systems.
	Excellent analytical, technical, and problem-solving abilities.
	Strong communication, coordination, and teamwork skills.
	Relevant professional registration/certification, such as COREN, will be an added advantage.


Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CVs to: [email protected] using “Application – Structural Engineer” as the subject of the mail.

Inventory Manager Job at TeamAce Limited




        
    

        
        TeamAce Limited - Our client, a reputable organization in the FMCG sector, is recruiting suitable candidates to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Inventory Manager 

Job Location: Abuja (FCT)
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Summary


	As the Inventory Manager, you will be responsible for ensuring inventory accuracy, maintaining stock integrity, and overseeing inventory control processes across assigned warehouses.


Responsibilities
     

            
    




	Oversee inventory transactions and ensure stock accuracy across assigned warehouses
	Conduct stock reconciliations, cycle counts, and investigate inventory discrepancies
	Prepare inventory reports and monitor inventory performance against KPIs
	Collaborate with Warehouse, Sales, Procurement, Finance, and Logistics teams to maintain inventory accuracy
	Drive inventory control improvements and support operations across assigned locations.


Requirements


	Bachelor's Degree in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Business Administration, Accounting, or a related field
	Must have 3–5 years of experience in Inventory Management, Warehouse Operations, or Supply Chain within the FMCG, Manufacturing, or Distribution sector
	Strong knowledge of inventory control, stock reconciliation, warehouse operations, and inventory reporting
	Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and experience using ERP systems (Business Central, Odoo, SAP, or similar).


Salary
NGN350,000 - NGN400,000 Monthly Net.
